SUMMARY

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Technical Leader	01/2022 - 09/2025 KPIT Technologies Ltd.		Bengaluru, India RAJOR − Cloud Cost Optimization Platform
Built AI-driven instance recommendation engine for Kubernetes workloads across
AWS/GCP/Azure.
Applied ML models (Random Forest, GBM, Bayesian Optimization) using real-time pricing and Prometheus metrics.
Reduced execution costs by 30–40% while maintaining SLA compliance.
Gen Ai Assistant
Designed RAG pipeline with LangChain, HuggingFace embeddings, and FAISS to improve factual accuracy.
Fine-tuned domain-specific LLMs, deployed via FastAPI microservices on Kubernetes.
Delivered 40% accuracy improvement and cut manual support costs by 25%.
FAHOR − Energy G Cost-Aware Prompt Router
Developed a Pareto-optimized routing system balancing cost and carbon emissions for LLM queries.
Integrated CodeCarbon for carbon tracking; routed between lightweight SLMs and LLMs.
Achieved 12% cost reduction and 15% emission reduction while preserving accuracy.
Automotive Data Analytics Platform
Built NER models for vehicle diagnostics (DTCs) and deployed via FastAPI = AWS SageMaker.
Designed BigQuery models and dashboards in Tibco Spotfire.
Improved automotive EV analytics reporting and customer insights.
Data Scientist	04/2015 - 02/2021
Sonata Software Ltd.	Bengaluru, India
Multicenter Recommendation Engine
Developed ML = Deep learning Recommendation System using Matrix Factorization on AWS.
This helped adding revenue by recommending and upselling of packages.
Service Bot G NLP POCs
Built conversational AI assistant using Rasa.
Conducted NLP and computer vision POCs for the travel domain.
